name: Wind Finance
description: A read-only Wind financial data plugin. Query market data and company profiles through a user-authorized official HTTPS API or enterprise gateway. It never places trades.
whenToUse: Use for Wind stock or index quotes and company profiles. Add a compatible Wind API gateway host and credential in the plugin details first.

wind_status.description: Test the current Wind API connection with a read-only GET /v1/status request.

wind_quote.description: Query stock or index quotes. This tool is read-only and never places, cancels, or modifies trades.

wind_company.description: Query a company profile. This tool is read-only and never places, cancels, or modifies trades.
